chunks: Who will speak to the people when in the cradle and when in the prime of life, and will be among the upright and doers of good.
ai.seo_question: What does it mean that Jesus spoke in the cradle and was among the Salihin?
ai.summary: This verse highlights the miraculous speech of Prophet Jesus (Isa) in infancy, serving as a divine sign to validate his prophethood and counter the doubts of his contemporaries. In Shia scholarly tradition, this event is often viewed as a precursor to the occultation and speech of Imam al-Mahdi, emphasizing the continuity of divine authority. It affirms his status among the Salihin, linking his unique miracle to the broader theme of righteous leadership.
